basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a recent convert to the universe of Elite Dangerous and a newcomer to Reddit. I'm an IT student based in Portland, Oregon, with a keen interest in space exploration games and coding. When I'm not studying or gaming, I love hiking the scenic trails of Oregon. My online hours vary, but I'm usually active in the evenings after classes. I'm single and enjoy connecting with fellow gamers and tech enthusiasts online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in IT, thanks to my ongoing studies at a local community college. I’m also teaching myself game development through online tutorials and coding bootcamps. My interest in space games like Elite Dangerous stems from a childhood fascination with astronomy.
